purpose: This table is the cleaned carrier reference lookup for the nycflights13-derived pipeline, mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full legal airline name for the 16 carriers that flew from New York City in 2013; it feeds joins from flight-level fact tables that only carry the carrier code.
usage: Join downstream flight tables to this table on carrier_code to resolve a human-readable carrier_name; both columns are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) and carrier_code is unique across all 16 rows, so no null-handling or dedupe logic is needed when consuming this table.
limitations: All three Airbyte capture-metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped as pipeline artifacts with no business meaning; the dataset covers only the 16 carriers observed in the 2013 NYC-origin flights and is not a general-purpose carrier registry.
